title: persea minutiloba
intro: Persea minutiloba, commonly known as Mexican tamanu or Peruvian tamanu, is a plant species native to Central and South America, valued for its unique properties and multiple uses. The health benefits of Persea minutiloba include its ability to promote wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic effects, making it a popular choice for topical applications. The bioactive constituents of Persea minutiloba include calophyllic acid and other triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
